0.npc_text: The woods are dangerous. What brings you?

ronald_ask_root.npc_text: Ask what you want. The trees do not wait for us to finish talking.

player_choices.text: Why do you live out here in the forest by yourself?
Do you know any secrets of the forest?

ronald_ask_why_alone.npc_text: Because people make more noise than weather and leave worse signs behind. Out here, things mean what they look like. Hunger looks like hunger. A trail looks like a trail. A beast that wants your throat usually gives you the courtesy of showing teeth first.

player_choices.text: So you trust the forest more than town.

ronald_ask_why_alone_2.npc_text: Quiet and lonely are not the same thing. Quiet lets a man think. Driftwatch never learned the difference.

ronald_ask_forest_secret.npc_text: There is an old path deeper in, nearly swallowed by brush now. Used to lead to a cabin. Folk said an old witch lived there once. Nothing dramatic. Just a hard old woman who outlived everyone who wanted her gone. Died of age, in the end. Cabin's still there if the woods have not finished taking it back.

player_choices.text: You are telling me where to look.

ronald_ask_forest_secret_2.npc_text: I am telling you there is a path worth cutting if you have the strength for it. Take an axe. Expect thorns, roots, and bad footing. The woods do not give shelter to men who only half-mean it.

ronald_friendly_root.npc_text: If you have something worth saying, say it plainly.

player_choices.text: Ask how the woods have been treating him.
Ask what sign a fool usually misses.

ronald_friendly_check_in.npc_text: You look like you have something on your mind.

player_choices.text: How have the woods been treating you?

ronald_friendly_offer_help.npc_text: Help is cheap to offer. Less common to see through.

player_choices.text: If something needs doing, say it straight.

ronald_friendly_watch_for.npc_text: Most men get themselves hurt before they even know what to watch for.

player_choices.text: Then tell me the sign they miss.

ronald_friendly_respect.npc_text: Go on, then. Get it out of your system.

player_choices.text: You read these woods better than most men read a street.

ronald_friendly_check_in_strong.npc_text: Wet, mostly. Still better company than town. You asking without prying is new, though.

ronald_friendly_check_in_weak.npc_text: Same as ever. Mud, tracks, and things with teeth.

ronald_friendly_check_in_fail.npc_text: I am still standing. That answers most of it.

ronald_friendly_offer_help_strong.npc_text: Good. A man who can carry his weight is rarer than he should be. I remember useful offers.

ronald_friendly_offer_help_weak.npc_text: Maybe. Woods have a way of sorting talk from work.

ronald_friendly_offer_help_fail.npc_text: If I need something done, I will ask. I do not collect favors I do not trust.

ronald_friendly_watch_for_strong.npc_text: Silence. Birds stop first, then the rest. Men notice the teeth when they should have noticed the quiet.

ronald_friendly_watch_for_weak.npc_text: Broken brush. Wrong wind. Too much stillness. None of it helps if you only start looking once you are afraid.

ronald_friendly_watch_for_fail.npc_text: What a fool misses depends on what kind of fool he is. You will have to narrow that down.

ronald_friendly_respect_strong.npc_text: You notice more than most. Good. Woods are wasted on men who only ever look at the ground in front of them.

ronald_friendly_respect_weak.npc_text: Hm. Better that than empty praise, I suppose.

ronald_friendly_respect_fail.npc_text: Flattery does not cut brush or keep wolves off a trail.

ronald_quest_root.npc_text: If this is about work, say so. If not, speak faster.

player_choices.text: A Mosswatch guard said you needed help with a wolf pack.
A Mosswatch guard said you needed help with a wolf pack.
I am ready to track the pack.

ronald_quest_referral.npc_text: Four of them, bold enough to range too near my ground and smart enough to scatter when I hunt them alone. That is the trouble with wolves that stop fearing men. If you mean to help, stay steady and do not chase what breaks first.

player_choices.text: I will help you clear them out.

ronald_quest_after_fight.npc_text: Good. I could feel the woods settling before I saw you come back. They were ranging too close for too long. You held when it mattered.

player_choices.text: It was your ground. I just helped keep it.
You did most of the real work.

ronald_quest_after_fight_grounded.npc_text: Maybe. But you stayed when most men would have found a reason not to. That counts. Go collect your coin from the guard who sent you. If you keep coming out this way, you know where my door is.

player_choices.text: I will collect the pay and come by again.
